schemes.title: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
schemes.description: An income support scheme for all landholding farmer families.

schemes.title: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
schemes.description: Crop insurance scheme to provide insurance coverage and financial support to the farmers in the event of failure of any of the notified crop.
schemes.eligibility: All farmers including sharecroppers and tenant farmers growing notified crops in the notified areas.

schemes.title: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) Scheme
schemes.description: Provides farmers with timely access to credit for their cultivation and other needs.
schemes.eligibility: Farmers, animal husbandry and fisheries farmers.

schemes.title: Soil Health Card Scheme
schemes.description: A scheme to provide every farmer with a soil health card, which will help them in deciding the quality of their soil and the type of crops they should sow.
